description.value: Sunset Rink is a City of Vancouver municipal indoor ice facility in the Sunset neighbourhood of south Vancouver, supporting both recreational skating and ice hockey. As a civic recreation centre, it serves the surrounding community year-round and is managed under Vancouver Parks, Recreation and Culture. Touring cyclists passing through or staying nearby may find it a useful landmark and potential rest stop.
